relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the expression of P/Q type channels was significantly increased by more than 3-fold in SNI-treated ipsilateral L4 ganglia compared with sham condition (n = 4, p = 0.045; Figure 4G).

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Using immunohistochemistry staining, we showed that the expression of CaVα2-δ1 was upregulated by about 2-fold in GCaMP6 positive DRG neuron somata following SNI treatment (Figure 4H).

relationships.subject: GABA-B receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: These data demonstrate that GABA-B receptor mediated inhibition of CaV channels is upregulated in Trpv1+ DRG terminals during neuropathic pain states.

key_findings: Spared nerve injury increases Ca2+ transient amplitude in Trpv1-lineage DRG central terminals in lamina I and IIo, mediated by N- and P/Q-type channels.
GABA-B (baclofen) inhibition of terminal Ca2+ transients is potentiated in lamina I after SNI.
